name: Enthusiast
editorial_article: Released on June 14, 2013, via Modeselektor’s influential Monkeytown Records, Enthusiast stands as a landmark project for the Berlin-based producer Siriusmo (Moritz Friedrich). Following a period of intense creative exploration and a tongue-in-cheek narrative involving the rejection of an "outrageously expensive" orchestral recording project, Enthusiast arrived as a bold statement of artistic independence and stylistic breadth. The record is a sprawling, 13-track exploration that refuses to settle into a single genre, instead opting to weave together neo-disco, electro-pop, intricate hip-hop beats, and heavy, UK bass-influenced sound design. \n\nWhat defines Enthusiast is its frantic, playful energy—a signature trait of Siriusmo’s production style. The tracks often feel like sonic experiments, shifting abruptly yet fluidly between dancefloor-ready hooks and dense, idiosyncratic listening passages. By avoiding the pitfalls of a homogenous sound palette, Siriusmo created a project that resonates with both club-focused listeners and those seeking sophisticated electronic compositions. Enthusiast solidified Siriusmo's reputation within the German electronic scene as an artist capable of marrying high-concept production with raw, unfiltered enthusiasm, proving that polish does not have to come at the expense of an artist's signature idiosyncrasy. The album remains a defining example of the label’s forward-thinking output in the early 2010s.
editorial_pitch: Released in 2013 on the Monkeytown imprint, Enthusiast serves as a high-water mark for Siriusmo's unique brand of eclectic, multi-genre electronica, blending chaotic energy with meticulous production. Spanning disco house, electro-pop, hip-hop, and UK bass, the album captures a moment of creative transition and refinement for the Berlin-based artist.
